text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Doto! Here's a present 
from me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-Not only did you remember, but you even 
got me a p-p-present...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Of course! How could I forget?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, the present is none other 
than an A2 clear poster of my glorious, 
radiant self!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, *sniff*. I will treasure this very, 
very much...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, but... if I hold onto it, it might 
get dirty, torn, or catch fire... 
maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If something were to happen to the 
present Opera O-san gave me... I... I 
would just...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I think I really should, g-g-g-give 
this back to youuu...!
